editorial.where: Canopy reference products and imagery that spans dates
editorial.finding: The heading grants the canopy mapping product reference-product status, which the section does not establish. The later disclosure explicitly acknowledges that this part of the expected claim has no recorded supporting use.

editorial.where: Expectations not supported — Kaiser OUTPERFORMS expectation
editorial.finding: The categorical CONTRADICTED disclosure reports losses but omits the same page-9 block's result that OSM-label training beat baseline Ia by 1.5 percentage points. The outcome depends on the baseline; the disclosure should include this favorable comparison alongside the losses.

Claims about the search and sourcing history—expectations registered before reading, resolution through full-text search, exclusive use of the brief, and no abstract or outside reading—are not backed by the supplied citations. The blocks cannot verify that procedural history.
The assertion that no Edmonds canopy-accuracy measurement exists in the knowledge base exceeds the supplied evidence. These excerpts establish only that no such measurement is presented here.

The reported ledger statuses, recorded uses, repeated full-text searches, and claims that nothing ingested confirms or refutes the Benedek expectation lack supporting ledger or search evidence in the supplied material. The cited Benedek passage establishes challenges, not an exhaustive absence of relevant findings.
